cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：在别处

cards.example_en: The moon will emerge from behind the clouds tonight.
cards.example_zh: 今晚月亮会从云层后面露出来。

cards.example_en: An error in the timetable sent our class to the wrong room.
cards.example_zh: 时间表上的一处错误让我们班走错了教室。

cards.example_en: It is a fact that sound travels faster through water than through air.
cards.example_zh: 声音在水里比在空气里传得更快，这是事实。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：最喜欢的
cards.example_zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

cards.example_en: I feed the goldfish before I leave for school.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：鱼（名词）
cards.example_en: Mum steamed fish with ginger for dinner tonight.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈今晚用姜蒸了鱼当晚餐。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：两星期
cards.example_en: We visited Uncle for a fortnight during the summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 暑假期间我们在叔叔家住了两星期。

cards.example_en: My aunt teaches violin at a college in Germany.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑在德国一所学院教小提琴。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：高兴的
cards.example_en: I am glad the lost cat found its way back home.
cards.example_zh: 我很高兴那只走失的猫自己找到了回家的路。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：希腊的
cards.example_en: Greek salad was the most popular dish at the food fair.
cards.example_zh: 希腊沙拉是美食节上最受欢迎的菜。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：马（名词）
cards.example_en: A tired horse drank from the bucket beside the stable.
cards.example_zh: 一匹疲惫的马在马厩旁边的桶里喝水。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：重要性
cards.example_en: Mum stressed the importance of breakfast before a test.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈强调了考试前吃早餐的重要性。

cards.example_en: I intend to visit my grandparents this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我打算这个周末去看望爷爷奶奶。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：共同的
cards.example_en: The two classes made a joint poster for Sports Day.
cards.example_zh: 两个班为运动会做了一张共同的海报。
